title: What Veterinary Technicians Do
description: Veterinary technicians are the nurses of the animal world: they triage, place IV catheters, draw blood, take radiographs, monitor anesthesia, assist in surgery, perform lab work, and educate pet owners. Credentialed techs work under veterinarians in clinics, hospitals, labs, zoos, and shelters.
key_points: The nurses of the animal world
requirements: Associate or bachelor's degree from an AVMA-accredited program
VTNE (Veterinary Technician National Exam) for credentialing
State credential: LVT, RVT, or CVT depending on state
CPR and fear-free handling training
Continuing education for renewal
